title: Convergence of finite element approximations for the one-dimensional stochastic Burgers equation with additive trace-class noise
summary: This paper investigates finite element approximations of the one-dimensional viscous stochastic Burgers equation with additive trace-class noise. For the $P_2$ finite element spatial semi-discretization, we derive strong error estimates that are optimal with respect to regularity in \(L^p([0,T] \times Ω;H_{D}^{α,q})\) for \(p,q\in[2,\infty)\) and \(α\in[-1,0]\), as well as an almost regularity-optimal estimate in \(L^p(Ω;C([0,T];L^\infty(\mathcal{O})))\). Furthermore, we derive weak error estimates for moments of both terminal $L^q$-norms and space-time $L^p(0,T;L^q(\mathcal{O}))$-norms,…
